learnings.question: Which economist, writing in 1971, first observed that an information-rich world creates a scarcity of human attention because information itself consumes the attention of whoever receives it?
learnings.learning: In 1971, economist Herbert Simon observed that in an information-rich world, the growing wealth of information creates a scarcity of attention, since information itself consumes the attention of whoever receives it.
learnings.articleTitle: Everybody wants your attention, but not everything deserves it.

learnings.question: In the hadith collection 40 Hadith an-Nawawi, leaving aside whatever does not concern a person is described as part of the perfection of what?
learnings.learning: Hadith 12 of 40 Hadith an-Nawawi states that part of the perfection of one's Islam is leaving aside that which does not concern him.
learnings.articleTitle: Everybody wants your attention, but not everything deserves it.

learnings.question: In the 1880s, which psychologist demonstrated that people forget roughly 80% of newly learned information within 24 hours unless they actively work to recall it?
learnings.learning: Back in the 1880s, Hermann Ebbinghaus demonstrated that we forget about 80% of what we learn within 24 hours unless we actively force ourselves to recall it.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: A hadith in Sahih Muslim states that when a person dies, all their deeds end except three: ongoing charity, a righteous child who prays for them, and one other. What is the third deed?
learnings.learning: The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said that when a human being dies, all their deeds come to an end except for three: ongoing charity, beneficial knowledge, or a righteous child who prays for them (Sahih Muslim 1631).
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: In the Scrum agile framework, which of the following is NOT one of the three officially defined roles?
learnings.learning: Scrum defines only three official roles — Product Owner, Scrum Master, and Developers — and notably has no 'Project Manager' role.

learnings.question: In Scrum, which artifact visually tracks how much work remains during a Sprint so the team can see if they're on schedule?
learnings.learning: The Burndown Chart is a Scrum artifact that visualizes a Sprint's progress by showing the remaining work, helping teams track whether they're on schedule.

learnings.question: In Islamic theology, what Arabic term — mentioned in Quran 2:30 — refers to humanity's role as a steward or caretaker of the Earth?
learnings.learning: The Quran (2:30) describes humanity's role using the term 'khalifah' — a steward or caretaker entrusted with responsibility over the Earth.

learnings.question: In Islamic teaching, worshiping Allah, serving as khalifah (steward) of the Earth, and living life as a test of faith are described as the three central roles behind what?
learnings.learning: Islamic teaching describes three central roles behind the purpose of human life: worshiping Allah, serving as khalifah (steward) of the Earth, and living life as a test of faith and conduct in preparation for the Hereafter.

learnings.question: Which hadith collection records the Prophet Muhammad asking, 'Shall I not be a grateful servant?'
learnings.learning: The Prophet Muhammad's rhetorical question, 'Shall I not be a grateful servant?', is recorded in Sahih Bukhari (1130), illustrating that gratitude lies at the heart of worship in Islam.

learnings.question: In the PCIe power management specification, which low-power state is a very light sleep that lets the link quickly 'wake up,' designed for very short periods of idleness?
learnings.learning: L0s is a PCIe low-power state representing a very light sleep that allows the link to resume activity quickly, designed specifically for brief periods of idleness.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe

learnings.question: Among PCIe's power management states, which deepest sleep state offers the greatest power savings but also takes the longest time to wake up from?
learnings.learning: PCIe's L2 state is the deepest power-saving mode — the device is almost completely powered down, maximizing energy savings at the cost of the longest wake-up time.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe

learnings.question: In Islamic theology, which term refers to the actual, unfolding occurrence of events in a person's life, as opposed to Allah's complete and eternal written plan?
learnings.learning: Qada' refers to the actual occurrence and unfolding of events in one's life, shaped by actions and decisions, while Qadr is Allah's complete and eternal plan and knowledge of all things.
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada’ and Qadr

learnings.question: A hadith in Jami at-Tirmidhi (3573) states Allah responds to every sincere Muslim supplication, as long as it isn't for something sinful or for severing family ties. What is one of the two guaranteed outcomes it describes?
options: He requires a witness to validate it
He ignores it until repeated seven times
He always delays it until the afterlife
learnings.learning: A hadith in Jami at-Tirmidhi (3573) states that Allah either grants a sincere Muslim's supplication directly or wards off an equivalent amount of evil from them, as long as the request isn't sinful or for severing family ties.
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada’ and Qadr

learnings.question: Applying the 80/20 Pareto Principle to the Quran's vocabulary, the top 20 most frequent words were found to accumulate to roughly what percentage of the entire text — far short of the 80% the principle might predict?
learnings.learning: Contrary to what the 80/20 Pareto Principle might predict, the top 20 most frequently repeated words in the Quran account for only about 20.83% of its total text.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python

learnings.question: Classical Arabic is estimated to contain roughly how many distinct words, compared to the approximately 170,000 found in the Oxford English Dictionary?
learnings.learning: Classical Arabic is estimated to contain around 12 million distinct words compared to roughly 170,000 in the Oxford English Dictionary — a ratio of about 71 Arabic words for every one English word.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python
